notes.title: Patch #1 – July 25th, 2025
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve just released Patch #1 for Vessels of Decay — this is the first major post-launch update, and it includes a wide range of fixes and improvements across combat, abilities, movement, level progression, environment, and more. This patch improves the overall stability and experience of the game. Some of these changes may seem minor, but together they make a big difference.


[h2][b]Combat & Abilities Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed abilities having [b]no cooldown[/b] for Freja.
[*] Fixed [b]abilities breaking[/b] in the sewers
[*] Fixed issue where abilities from a [b]previous save could carry over[/b] to a new one.
[*] Fixed some [b]abilities[/b] dealing way [b]too much damage[/b].
[*] Fixed some [b]abilities[/b] dealing [b]no damage[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]Freja being able to absorb[/b] even when no enemies were nearby.
[*] Fixed bug where [b]players could grab bosses[/b] with sword throw.
[*] Fixed [b]cooldown not updating[/b] correctly when switching characters.
[*] Removed [b]Freja’s skills menu[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]Slime Throw[/b] stopping when swapped with Parry using light attack slot.
[*] Fixed [b]absorb tutorial[/b] breaking if players swapped light and regular attacks.
[*] Switching characters now properly [b]resets equipped slimes[/b].
[*] Fixed Freja [b]unlocking abilities too early[/b] in Chapter 2.
[*] Fixed Freja [b]receiving a removed ability[/b] when absorbing a Gas Slime.
[*] Fixed Freja [b]not having her sword[/b] when entering some chapters.
[*] Reduced [b]knockback[/b] from [b]critical hits[/b] for better combat flow.
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Character and Movement Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the [b]player could become tiny[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]inaccurate diagonal inputs[/b] when using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed player [b]becoming invincible[/b] at 0 HP.
[*] Fixed bug where [b]player couldn’t sprint[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]player being unable to swing[/b] in some areas.
[*] Fixed [b]player being unable to execute[/b] enemies.
[*] Fixed bug where player [b]floated during the Stallo fight[/b].
[*] Fixed issue where [b]Freja’s ability was visible when playing as Mud[/b].
[*] Fixed issues with [b]climbing walls[/b] and [b]vines[/b].
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Level Progression fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed [b]Loading checkpoint[/b] in certain areas of the game resulting in a [b]softlock[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]softlock when trying to execute[/b] two berserkers at the same time.
[*] Fixed issue where player could [b]leave the troll boss fight early[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]Freja NPC reappearing[/b] after dying during Nattramn cutscene.
[*] Fixed [b]berserker getting stuck[/b] in walls.
[*] Fixed [b]defeated enemies reappearing[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]shortcuts[/b] and [b]skips[/b] by jumping over ledges.
[*] Fixed bug in Chapter 2 where players could [b]get stuck after defeating hand enemies[/b].
[*] Fixed [b]Stag heads incorrectly respawning[/b].
[*] Removed [b]XP[/b] orb drops from [b]Witherarms[/b] to balance progression.
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Visual bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed [b]various crashes[/b] and visual bugs affecting stability and presentation across the game.
[*] Fixed [b]shadows not appearing[/b] correctly in the sewers.
[*] Fixed [b]borders not displaying[/b] properly on non-16:9 aspect ratios.
[*] Fixed [b]UI disappearing[/b] during final boss.
[*] Fixed [b]water visual bug[/b] in the sewers.
[*] Fixed [b]mud disappearing[/b] during the Troll execution scene.
[*] Fixed [b]missing textures[/b] in certain areas.
[*] Fixed [b]visual bug[/b] with "Climb Collision Tiles" showing during gameplay and added failsafe.
[*] Fixed [b]water reflections[/b] appearing over buildings in the Drowned City.
[*] Fixed [b]missing tiles[/b] in Shaman Lair Upper circular area.
[*] Updated [b]control display in menus[/b] to reflect gameplay abilities.
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Controls and Menu Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several [b]menu-related bugs[/b], including the pause/skill menu opening during death and ability prices resetting on game restart.
[*] Changed [b]Yes/No order[/b] on "New Game" and "Reset Level" to make “Cancel” the default.
[*] Disabled [b]vibration and muted sounds[/b] during reset/migration to avoid lingering effects.
[*] You can no longer [b]rebind the pause button[/b] (fixed PS5 options menu issues).
[*] Fixed [b]ability prices resetting[/b] when restarting the game.
[*] Fixed error when trying to[b] save to a full disk[/b].
[/list]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2][b]Environment Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]missing colliders[/b] and [b]collision barriers[/b] in various areas to improve player navigation and prevent projectile escapes.
[*] Fixed multiple issues with objects and level geometry, including [b]chairs[/b] and[b] couches stuck inside walls[/b].
[*] Resolved [b]player respawn issues[/b] where players could spawn out of bounds in certain locations.
[*] Adjusted [b]stall door mechanics[/b] to ensure [b]proper destruction[/b] based on depth.
[*] Fixed [b]puzzle elements[/b], such as the spin cylinder [b]remaining interactable[/b] after completion.
[*] Added [b]invisible platforms[/b] during the [b]second Gloson charge[/b] to prevent players from falling off the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Last news update of 2022
notes.notes:
Here’s the last news update of 2022!

Since I’m (finally) done with the platforming, I could move on to fix bugs and work on other areas you gave feedback on during the playtest.

One very important feedback you gave was that the enemy attack telegraphing needed improvement. So, I have worked on improving the telegraphing for both the Mara (Jumper Enemy) and the Slime (Spike Enemy). Some of you felt like the troll boss had too few attacks, so I've done some work on that as well, adding a new attack, as well as having the troll choose between different attacks based on what the player is doing/positioned, rather than cycling through them as it was before. This makes the Troll feel much more alive and calculated.

I have also changed up the level design to include the new platforming, which I think turned out really well. It makes the levels feel more interesting and creates a fun challenge between the fighting and the story elements. Which is something I’ve been striving for since the beginning of this project.

Many many many more minor things have been tweaked this week, but some of the more important ones I've listed below.
[list]
[*]Updates and Implemented Features this week:
[*]Improved level design for intro area.
[*]Better telegraphing for (Spike Enemy).
[*]Better telegraphing for Mara (jumper enemy).
[*]Enemies “Shake” on hit for an extra punch.
[*]Enemies only enter a stunned state if they can be executed.
[*]Fixed enemy hit state.
[*]Added delay SFX along with reverb for better room presence.
[*]Music does not restart when entering a new room with the same music.
[*]Tweaked intro cutscene timing.
[*]Shortened intro cutscene text for readability.
[*]Can abort sit/wait state with attack input.
[/list]

I’m really looking forward to next year when I will finally have the time to start working on new enemy types and to continue with the expansion of the world in Vessels of Decay. 

And in case I forget (🍹 🍸 🥂 🎆 🍾 )  tomorrow! I wish you all a Happy New Year!
